With regards to our service and how we operate, please find a brief summary below:

Service: 
 
•	We firstly never charge any commission, at all. There are no added costs and you know exactly the costings to your adverts prior to placing them.

•	We offer 3 packages to decide between (see below). These packages differ in levels of exposure your advert receives; Standard, Premium or Branded. 
               The pricing ranges from £299 +VAT, £399 +VAT and £499 +VAT. 
•	You will receive a dedicated Account Manager (myself) to help throughout your campaign. We are on hand to offer advice and guidance throughout.

Package Job Board Options: 
 
Standard Advert
Job Boards = Reed (sponsored), Total Jobs, Indeed (PPC), Jobsite, Job Flurry, Adzuna, Facebook Jobs, Google for Jobs, CareerJet, Find A Job, Zip Recruiter, Trovit, Zoek, Glassdoor, Job Rapido and Twitter. 
 
Premium Advert

This advert is 100% about you, featuring your logo - and nothing about us. Branded ads also enable you to maximise your employer profile in your industry

-	50+ pricing available on request 


Managed Service

Finally, I wanted to make you aware that we also offer a Managed Advert solution.

We will take all the hard work away from you!  

With this, we will filter and contact the applications that closely resemble the ideal candidate you wish to employ. 

-	We will look to arrange 3 interviews initially (per role) and we work the shortlisted candidates at different points throughout the day in order to increase the likelihood that they pick up the phone and engage regarding your position. 

-	We are finding that the Managed advert option brings a greater chance of success to your campaigns. 

-	The fact that we can contact candidates via different methods - call, email, text message – at different points throughout the day, often means that the candidate will engage with your role. 

-	If, after the first 3 interviews for your role, you are still looking for the idea candidate, we will then take your feedback on board and will look to book another 3 interviews for you. 


Benefits:
•	Less time and effort for the employer
•	Only view the BEST candidates
•	Improved success rate
•	Only interview pre-screened candidates
•	Personality Indicators

-	5x Managed Advert (add-on) = £1,199 +VAT

-	Once payment is received, and the advert confirmed, I will be quick to place live for you.

Hi Steph,

Thank you for taking the time on the phone with me this morning, lovely speaking with you. 

As discussed, for your reference, I’ve included our essential information below:

Our Service: 

•	We specialise in flat-fee recruitment and we never charge commission. 
•	Our service breaks down across two main areas. Optimising / Designing your advert and exposing your role on 12/13+ of the UK’s biggest job boards in order to attract the very best candidates. 
•	Our adverts run for a full 28 days and you receive full access to our Applicant Tracking Software (Portal) to view, filter and respond to candidates. 
•	You will receive a dedicated Account Manager to help throughout your campaign. We are on hand to offer advice and guidance throughout. 

We offer three packages to decide from; Standard, Premium or Branded. 
 
Package Job Board Options: 
 
Standard Advert
Job Boards = Reed (sponsored), Total Jobs, Indeed (PPC), Jobsite, Job Flurry, Adzuna, Facebook Jobs, Google for Jobs, CareerJet, Find A Job, Zip Recruiter, Trovit, Zoek, Glassdoor, Job Rapido and Twitter. 
 
Premium Advert 
Job Boards = LinkedIn (sponsored), CV Library (sponsored), Reed (sponsored), Total Jobs, Indeed (PPC), Jobsite, Job Flurry, Adzuna, Facebook Jobs, Google for Jobs, CareerJet, Find A Job, Zip Recruiter, Trovit, Zoek, Glassdoor, Job Rapido and Twitter.
 
Branded Premium Advert
Job Boards including Company Logo and Company Name = Reed (sponsored), CV Library (sponsored), LinkedIn (sponsored), Total Jobs (sponsored), Jobsite.  
Job Boards including Company name: Indeed (PPC),  Job Flurry, Adzuna, Facebook Jobs, CareerJet and Glassdoor.
 

I have also collated a selection of our credit pack pricing for your consideration as you mentioned that you have a number of vacancies currently – this will help bring down the costs of each advert.

Purchase in a package (3+ adverts) saves on time and future cost. Unused adverts never expire and remain on your account until required. 

Package Pricing Options: 
 
•	1x Standard Advert = £299 +VAT               
•	3x Standard Adverts = £799 +VAT             (Cost per credit = £266)
•	5x Standard Adverts = £1,199 +VAT          (Cost per credit = £239)

8+ Credit Packs available upon request.
  
Fully Managed Adverts - 
 
We can also fully manage your advert campaigns if required. With this, we will view, filter and contact positive applications. We aim to book you 3 interviews based on your ideal candidate criteria. 
 
•	1x Managed Advert add on (per role) = £299 +VAT 


Next Steps:

Once you have selected your preferred package I will get our copywriting team to optimise the advert(s) and after payment has been taken -  we can get them live as soon as possible for you. 

Do you have any information put together for the different roles you wish to advertise? If not – no problem. I can ask my optimising team to design you a fresh advert for any. 


I look forward to hearing your thoughts.

Hi Tracey,

My name is Kerrin, I am one of the Account Managers here at Talent Finder.

I am just contacting you following from your conversation with my colleague, Sami, today regarding how we can help with advertising any recruitment vacancies.


I have tried to be as comprehensive as I can with the information provided, though in short – we provide recruitment solutions. 

The more we can understand your processes/requirements and work closely with you – the more efficient and cost effective we can be as a recruitment partner. 


Please find our pricing/package information below for your consideration:


We offer three packages to decide from in terms of exposure provided; Standard, Premium or Branded. 


Our adverts run for a full 28 days and you receive full access to our Applicant Tracking Software (Portal) to view, filter and respond to candidates. 

You will receive a dedicated Account Manager (Myself) to help throughout your campaign. We are on hand to offer advice and guidance throughout. 


Package Job Board Options: 
 
Standard Advert
Job Boards = Reed (sponsored), Total Jobs, Indeed (PPC), Jobsite, Job Flurry, Adzuna, Facebook Jobs, Google for Jobs, CareerJet, Find A Job, Zip Recruiter, Trovit, Zoek, Glassdoor, Job Rapido and Twitter. 
 
Premium Advert 
Job Boards = LinkedIn (sponsored), CV Library (sponsored), Reed (sponsored), Total Jobs, Indeed (PPC), Jobsite, Job Flurry, Adzuna, Facebook Jobs, Google for Jobs, CareerJet, Find A Job, Zip Recruiter, Trovit, Zoek, Glassdoor, Job Rapido and Twitter.
 
Branded Premium Advert*
Job Boards including Company Logo and Company Name = Reed (sponsored), CV Library (sponsored), LinkedIn (sponsored), Total Jobs (sponsored), Jobsite.  
Job Boards including Company name: Indeed (PPC),  Job Flurry, Adzuna, Facebook Jobs, CareerJet and Glassdoor.

*We use Fully Branded Premium Adverts and will advertise your vacancy across all the job boards above.
This advert is 100% about you, featuring your logo - and nothing about us. Branded ads also enable you to maximise your employer profile in your industry


I have collated a series of our Credit Pack pricing for your consideration (below) as purchasing in bulk will help bring down the cost per advert.  

This is helpful and cost efficient if you have multiple sites or generally recruit a fair amount of staff per year as unused adverts never expire and remain on your account until required.

Hi Joanna,

Thank you for your time on the phone this morning.	


To quickly recap from the campaign: 

Chef – 62 applications 

Front of House Staff – 139 applications 


Both adverts received a fantastic response with the number of applications. 

We helped to filter the candidates for this position, highlighting applicants with the right experience. 


From this, we found: 

Chef – 19 green flagged || 9 blue flagged 

Front of House Staff – 11 green flagged || 47 blue flagged 


From the above, we fully understand and expect that some candidates might not meet your requirements. 

However, we would definitely feel that there should be some to consider and approach. 



One aspect that is extremely difficult, across all recruitment sectors, is contacting and engaging with candidates. 

Essentially – they are really difficult to get hold of. 


Did you manage to speak with anyone flagged possible? 

Did you attempt calling any candidates? 



For any future advert, I would strongly emphasise the need to consider our Managed advert option. 

Our Managed advert option includes the filtering done above, but – it includes my resourcing team contacting the positive candidates to make sure they are interested in your position and that their skills do reflect what they highlight in their CV. 

Once the candidate has been engaged to your role, we then speak with you regarding their suitability and possible interview date. 



You still have 1 advert credit remaining from the 3 previously purchased. This advert credit includes CV Filtering. 

My main recommendation is that you upgrade this CV Filtering to a Managed advert. 

The cost for this should be £200 +VAT, but I can discount this down to £150 +VAT for you. 


I then suggest that you place live one of the above positions for a fresh campaign – with our resourcing team helping. 


Hopefully then you will see the difference in both campaigns. 


If this is a success, which I am confident it would be, you will then have the option of placing the other role live under the same Managed campaign. 




What do you think? 


Is this something I can set up for you? 



To do this – it is really simple. 


We just need your confirmation and payment for the Managed advert upgrade. 


After this, please confirm which advert you would like to place live again and I can do the rest. 



I look forward to hearing from you and helping you again soon!

Hi Sophie, 
 
Thank you very much for your email. 
 
Yes – I might have a few suggestions to make that could help. 
 
 
Salary:
 
We could display the salary as £20,800 rather than £10 per hour. 
 
The rate of pay still works out the same; but sometimes displaying in a salary in a yearly basis is more attractive to candidates. 
 
 
Required Experience: 
 
One other suggestion would be the amount of experience required for the position.
 
Changing the wording to; “Ideally” from “at least” might help with the candidates who qualify for your position. 
 
If you did opt to reduce the required experience to 1-2 years; this would also help. 
 
 
Essentially, the number of candidates in your area / population currently looking for new work with 5+ years’ experience might be niche. 
 
For example; “The candidate will ideally have at least 1-2 years’ experience is tyre fitting, including car, commercial, agricultural and motorcycle tyres, run-flat tyres, wheel alignment and tyre repairs”. 
 
 
It will not stop applicants applying with more experience, but it might then encourage some candidates with less experience to apply for the role – therefore giving you more to consider. 
 
 
With the above being said, if you are not able / willing to consider candidates with less than 5 years’ experience, then obviously I would suggest not changing the current wording.  
 
 
I hope some of the above information helps. 
 
I have spoken with Kerrin who is your Account Manager here at Talent Finder – also CC’d in this email.

It was great speaking with you earlier.
 
As discussed, I wanted to quickly highlight the key areas to the Managed Advert process. 
 
It is essential that the below information is understood and adhered to in order to give the advert the best chance of succeeding however I totally appreciate that I was unable to intercept your call earlier and that we hadn’t yet had this conversation to set expectations.
 
 
Managed Advert:
 
 
•	Setting clear criteria. 
 
•	If you have not already, please highlight 3 key requirements for your position(s).
 
•	This information helps our resourcing team when viewing and filtering applicants in order to highlight suitable candidates. 
 
•	We are not head-hunting candidates. The candidates we contact have applied for your position. We judge based on the information they provide within their application and their input / enthusiasm on phone calls. 
 
 
 
•	Responding to potential candidates quickly. 
 
•	Our resourcing team aim to work as quickly as possible in order to engage with positive candidates. 
 
•	We ask that you commit to responding ideally within 24 hours (max 48 hours) when presented with potential candidates to interview. 
 
•	If you respond after the 48-hour period, the likelihood the candidate is available decreases. 
 
 
 
•	3 Interviews & feedback. 
 
•	We arrange up to 3 interviews. 
 
•	Feedback from these interviews is essential in order to determine how to move forward with additional interviews (if required). 
 
•	Once feedback is received, we will then look to arrange a further 3 interviews. 
 
 
 
•	How many candidates? 
 
•	The managed advert service is designed to find you one candidate for your position. 
 
•	This however is not set, and we never charge commission or additional fees. 
 
•	If you ideally require more than one applicant from the Managed process, please make your resourcing contact and your account manager aware. 
 
 
 
If you have any questions regarding the above information, please do not hesitate to call or email.

•	We offer 3 packages to decide between (see below). These packages differ in levels of exposure your advert receives; Standard, Premium or Branded. 
               The pricing ranges from £299 +VAT, £399 +VAT and £499 +VAT.

Standard Advert

Managed Service

Finally, I wanted to make you aware that we also offer a Managed Advert solution.

We will take all the hard work away from you!  

With this, we will filter and contact the applications that closely resemble the ideal candidate you wish to employ. 

-	We will look to arrange 3 interviews initially (per role) and we work the shortlisted candidates at different points throughout the day in order to increase the likelihood that they pick up the phone and engage regarding your position. 

-	We are finding that the Managed advert option brings a greater chance of success to your campaigns.

-	If, after the first 3 interviews for your role, you are still looking for the idea candidate, we will then take your feedback on board and will look to book another 3 interviews for you.

Service: 
 
•	We firstly never charge any commission, at all. There are no added costs and you know exactly the costings to your adverts prior to placing them.

•	Your advert is placed on 13+ of the UK’s biggest job boards for 28 days, in your specific location.
